The Overnight Shift

What happens when your code keeps working after you go to bed. I launched an execution engine on a Saturday evening and went to have dinner. When I came back, it was still running. When I went to bed, it was still running. When I woke up Sunday morning, it had completed 40% of a migration plan and hit a problem it couldn't solve without me. I made tea,
